synthetic QA profile only; no real student data',\n  tasks: [],\n  trace: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet server;\nlet browser;\nlet exitCode = 0;\n\nconst T = (label, detail = '') => {\n  report.trace.push({ t: new Date().toISOString(), label, detail });\n};\n\nfunction task(id, name, status, detail, evidence = {}) {\n  report.tasks.push({ id, name, status, detail, evidence });\n  if (status === 'FAIL') exitCode = 1;\n}\n\nasync function waitForServer() {\n  const deadline = Date.now() + 45_000;\n  let lastError = 'not attempted';\n  while (Date.now() < deadline) {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(`${baseURL}/api/health`);\n      if (response.ok) return await response.json();\n      lastError = `health status ${response.status}`;\n    } catch (error) {\n      lastError = String(error);\n    }\n    await delay(500);\n  }\n  throw new Error(`Amina server did not become healthy: ${lastError}`);\n}\n\nasync function shot(page, name) {\n  const path = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10_000 });\n  return path;\n}\n\nasync function visibleText(page) {\n  return (await page.evaluate(() => document.body.innerText || '')).replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim();\n}\n\n// Modals and sheet footers sit above the bottom nav, so a plain click can be\n// intercepted. Dismiss any overlay first, then dispatch the nav click directly.\nasync function navTo(page, index) {\n  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {\n    const overlay = await page.evaluate(() => {\n      const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div,section'));\n      return nodes.some((n) => {\n        const s = getComputedStyle(n);\n        return (s.position === 'fixed' || s.position === 'absolute') && Number(s.zIndex || 0) >= 40 && n.getBoundingClientRect().height > 200;\n      });\n    });\n    if (!overlay) break;\n    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');\n    await delay(250);\n  }\n  await page.evaluate((i) => {\n    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('nav button');\n    if (buttons[i]) buttons[i].click();\n  }, index);\n  await delay(600);\n}\n\nasync function onboard(page, { name, language }) {\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15_000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(name);\n  await page.getByRole('button', { name: language }).first().click();\n  // Conversational interview: advance by clicking the trailing (primary) action.\n  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {\n    await page.locator('button').last().click();\n    await delay(220);\n  }\n  const buttonCount = await page.locator('button').count();\n  await page.locator('button').nth(buttonCount - 2).click();\n  await page.locator('nav button').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15_000 });\n  await delay(500);\n}\n\ntry {\n  server = spawn('./node_modules/.bin/tsx', ['server.ts'], {\n    env: { ...process.env, PORT: '4174', NODE_ENV: 'production' },\n    stdio: 'ignore',\n    detached: true,\n  });\n  server.unref();\n  const health = await waitForServer();\n  T('server healthy', `status=${health.status} hasApiKey=${health.hasApiKey}`);\n\n  browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });\n  const context = await browser.newContext({\n    viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 1,\n  });\n  const page = await context.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 300) }); });\n\n  await page.goto(baseURL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30_000 });\n  await onboard(page, { name: 'Learner QA', language: /Français/ });\n  T('onboarding complete', 'profile=Learner QA language=fr');\n  const nav = page.locator('nav button');\n  T('nav destinations', `count=${await nav.count()}`);\n\n  // TASK 1 — From HOME, determine what to do next today.\n  await navTo(page, 0);\n  const homeText = await visibleText(page);\n  const homeShot = await shot(page, 'task1-home');\n  const hasNextAction = /What Should I Do Now|Que dois-je faire|ماذا أفعل/.test(homeText) ||\n    /Available Study Time|Temps d'étude/.test(homeText);\n  task(1, 'From HOME, determine what to do next today', hasNextAction ? Severity-ranked findings\n\n### F-01 — Saved items can be filed into no collection and then appear lost (P1, functional)\n- **Verified.** Learner-flow task 5 FAIL. Sequence: FEED card → \"Save to Collection\" → modal → \"Save Item\". The modal's Save button is only disabled while `isSaving`, so it is clickable with zero collections selected (`SaveToCollectionModal.tsx:196`). `handleSave` then calls `saveContent` with `collectionIds: []`; `saveItem` persists the item, and `handleSaveContent` shows the toast \"Saved to collection\" (`AppContext.tsx:926`).\n- **Exact behaviour (Verified in source + capture):** the item *is* written to storage, so it still appears under Review → Saved Items → \"All Saves\" (`ReviewScreen.tsx:67`, which lists all `savedItems`). But it belongs to no collection, so the **\"Saved & Collections\" screen shows \"Nothing saved here yet.\"** while the success toast is still on screen. Default collections always exist at this point (ensured in `AppContext.tsx:340`), so this is purely \"the learner did not tick a box\", not \"no collections exist\".\n- **Evidence:** `artifacts/learner-flow/task5-collections.png` — empty collection list and the \"Saved to collection\" toast in the same capture. `artifacts/learner-flow/learner-flow-report.json` (task 5 detail).\n- **Impact:** the confirmation message and the \"Saved & Collections\" destination both imply the item was filed somewhere it can be reopened; instead it is unfiled and invisible on that screen. It is a trust and findability defect in the save/revisit loop, not total data loss.\n- **Smallest safe fix (for a separate PR, not this audit):** in `SaveToCollectionModal.handleSave`, when `selectedColIds` is empty, either require a selection (disable Save until one is chosen) or default to a real collection before persisting. Either way the toast must reflect reality. Behaviour-preserving elsewhere.\n\n### F-02 — Product identity and teacher identity are conflated (P2, branding) — **already fixed on PR #7**\n- **Verified** on `main`. The persistent header renders \"Miss Nour\" as the app title with the learner name beneath (`AppShell.tsx:60`). Harness check \"product brand and teacher identity are distinct\" expects both \"Amina\" and \"Miss Nour\" and FAILs on `main`.\n- **Evidence:** `docs/audits/evidence/design-audit/04-home-mobile.png`.\n- **PR #7 already fixes this** (Verified): its `AppShell.tsx` renders `Amina` as the title with `Miss Nour · <name>` beneath. Running the audit against a build of PR #7's branch gives **25/25 checks passing**, including this one. See `docs/audits/evidence/pr7-verified/design-audit-report.json`.\n- **Consequence:** do not open a separate branding fix. Merging PR #7 resolves F-02 on `main`.\n\n### F-03 — French selection yields mixed-language UI (P1, localization) — **already fixed on PR #7**\n- **Verified** on `main`. With French selected: HOME shows \"Welcome, Learner QA!\", \"Your personal AI School Companion\", \"What Should I Do Now, Miss Nour?\"; FEED's intro is English (\"Nour is teaching you now\"); LIBRARY's search placeholder is English.\n- **Root cause (Verified):** `HomeScreen.tsx` has 27 and `FeedScreen.tsx` has 15 `isArabic ? … : 'English'` ternaries with no French branch, and `CurriculumBrowser.tsx:213` has no French placeholder. The `fr` dictionary exists in `translations.ts` but these strings are hard-coded.\n- **PR #7 already fixes the audited cases** (Verified): its `FeedScreen.tsx` adds `isFr` branches (\"Nour t'accompagne maintenant\", \"Un moment d'apprentissage choisi par Nour\"), and its `CurriculumBrowser.tsx` adds a `Rechercher…` placeholder. Running the audit against a build of PR #7's branch gives **25/25 checks passing**, including \"French Feed intro uses French UI copy\" and \"curriculum search placeholder is French in French mode\".\n- **Separate real i18n defect found while inspecting (still open on `main` and on PR #7):** `HomeScreen.tsx:397` renders `{isArabic ? 'دروس' : 'les'}` — the French word \"les\" is shown in the **English** UI. This is a genuine bug independent of F-03 and is not addressed by PR #7.\n- **Evidence:** `docs/audits/evidence/design-audit/04-feed-mobile.png` (baseline) vs `docs/audits/evidence/pr7-verified/` (PR #7).\n- **Consequence:** do not re-do the Feed/Library French work; merging PR #7 resolves those. The `HomeScreen.tsx:397` string remains a small, separate fix.\n\n### F-04 — The TypeScript quality gate does not block (P1, CI integrity)\n- **Verified, both by reproduction and by CI records.** `npm run lint` on `main` exits 1 with 11 errors, yet CI run [38888767348](https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Amina/actions/runs/38888767348) shows the \"Type check\" step conclusion = **success**. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` sets `continue-on-error: true` on that step.\n- **The 11 errors (Verified):** 8 × TS18047 in `teacherContextEngine.ts` (unreachable code after an unconditional `return` disables narrowing), 2 × TS18047 in `VirtualTeacherClassroom.tsx` (`targetLesson` nullable), 1 × TS2322 in `missionCompletion.ts` (`'practice'` missing from `EvidenceModality`).\n- **Status of the fix:** PR #11 removes `continue-on-error`, deletes the 87-line unreachable block, adds `'practice'` to `EvidenceModality` with an explicit `1.0` weight, and adds optional chaining. Independently verified here: 0 type errors, adaptive 39/39, integrity 72/72, build pass. PR #11 is still **draft and unmerged**.\n\n### F-05 — No full digital book reader (P2, product scope)\n- **Observed-not-verified.** `main` has no `BookReader`; \"Open Book\" opens `LessonStudyModal`. The product source of truth (PR #10) asks for full digital books, not only sample cards. Recovery notes indicate `BookReader.tsx` exists on the archive/design branches — so this is a **PR-only** capability, not on `main`.\n\n### F-06 — Production/deployment identity not verifiable from here (P1, blocked)\n- **Blocked.** `render.yaml` configures a Render web service named `amina`, branch `main`, health check `/api/health`, free plan. I probed `amina.onrender.com`, `amina-1.onrender.com`, and `miss-noor.onrender.com`; all returned **404** on `/api/health`. There is no recorded deployed URL or Render API token in this environment.\n- **What was checked:** `render.yaml` (blob `59bf2463`), the three host probes above, and the repo's GitHub Pages workflow (manual-only, and its own comment says Pages cannot serve the AI routes).\n- **Conclusion:** the deployed URL and deployed SHA are **not verified**. I did not guess and did not deploy.\n\n### F-07 — AI routes unexercised in this environment (informational)\n- No `GEMINI_API_KEY` was present, so `/api/chat`, `/api/tutor-*`, `/api/stt`, `/api/tts`, `/api/check-homework`, `/api/reconstruct-day` returned their documented degraded fallbacks. The app renders and the degraded paths are honest (\"I can't check this right now…\"), which is correct behaviour — but real model output was **not** exercised here and is **Unverified**.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Severity-ranked findings\n\n### F-01 — Saved items can be filed into no collection and then appear lost (P1, functional)\n- **Verified.** Learner-flow task 5 FAIL. Sequence: FEED card → \"Save to Collection\" → modal → \"Save Item\". The modal's Save button is only disabled while `isSaving`, so it is clickable with zero collections selected (`SaveToCollectionModal.tsx:196`). `handleSave` then calls `saveContent` with `collectionIds: []`; `saveItem` persists the item, and `handleSaveContent` shows the toast \"Saved to collection\" (`AppContext.tsx:926`).\n- **Exact behaviour (Verified in source + capture):** the item *is* written to storage, so it still appears under Review → Saved Items → \"All Saves\" (`ReviewScreen.tsx:67`, which lists all `savedItems`). But it belongs to no collection, so the **\"Saved & Collections\" screen shows \"Nothing saved here yet.\"** while the success toast is still on screen. Default collections always exist at this point (ensured in `AppContext.tsx:340`), so this is purely \"the learner did not tick a box\", not \"no collections exist\".\n- **Evidence:** `artifacts/learner-flow/task5-collections.png` — empty collection list and the \"Saved to collection\" toast in the same capture. `artifacts/learner-flow/learner-flow-report.json` (task 5 detail).\n- **Impact:** the confirmation message and the \"Saved & Collections\" destination both imply the item was filed somewhere it can be reopened; instead it is unfiled and invisible on that screen. It is a trust and findability defect in the save/revisit loop, not total data loss.\n- **Smallest safe fix (for a separate PR, not this audit):** in `SaveToCollectionModal.handleSave`, when `selectedColIds` is empty, either require a selection (disable Save until one is chosen) or default to a real collection before persisting. Either way the toast must reflect reality. Behaviour-preserving elsewhere.\n\n### F-02 — Product identity and teacher identity are conflated (P2, branding) — **already fixed on PR #7**\n- **Verified** on `main`. Merging PR #7 resolves F-02 on `main`.\n\n### F-03 — French selection yields mixed-language UI (P1, localization) — **already fixed on PR #7**\n- **Verified** on `main`.    "text": "# Amina / Miss Nour — audit addendum: modal occlusion defeats the Save fix (F-08)\n\n**Date:** 2026-10-22\n**Auditor:** OpenHands (authorized repository coding/auditing executor per issue #9)\n**Baseline for new findings:** `main` @ `86c1e73cf760069b1dd58fba994f3f3f0f49a00c`\n**Companion report:** `docs/audits/AMINA_FORENSIC_AUDIT_2026-10-22.md` (R1/R3)\n**Scope:** read-only investigation of the save/revisit loop, reproduced against a real production build. No production change, no merge, no deployment.\n\n> Status labels used below: **Verified** (reproduced with the recorded output/artifact), **Observed-not-verified**, **Hypothesis**, **Blocked**.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Why this addendum exists\n\nThe companion report's F-01 described a logic defect: the Save-to-Collection sheet allowed a save with no collection ticked, so the item was filed nowhere while a \"Saved to collection\" toast still appeared.\n\nThat logic defect is now addressed on **PR #15** (`fix/save-item-without-collection`, head `ec4f48ef74`), which disables **Save Item** until at least one collection is selected. Independently re-checked here: the guard is present, `npm run test:integrity` is 69/69, and a save that names a collection is discoverable in it.\n\nThis addendum records a **second, independent defect in the same flow** that the PR #15 guard does **not** fix, and that the PR's own test cannot detect, because the test calls the service directly and never clicks the button in a browser.\n\n---\n\n## 2. F-08 — The Save-to-Collection sheet's confirm button is physically unclickable (P1, functional)\n\n**Verified.** In a real headless browser, at both tested viewports, the **Save Item** button's centre hit-tests to an element that is **not** the button. A real pointer/touch click therefore never reaches it.\n\n| Viewport | Button rect (top–bottom) | Sheet rect (top–bottom) | Bottom nav (top–bottom) | `elementFromPoint` at button centre | Occluded |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 390×844 mobile | 761–789 | 397–697 | 774–844 | `NAV` | **Yes** |\n| 1365×900 desktop | 805–833 | 460–722 | 830–900 | `SPAN` | **Yes** |\n\nRead the geometry: the sheet claims `top: 397, bottom: 697`, but its button renders at `761–789`. The button is laid out **64px below the sheet's own bottom edge**, in the region occupied by the sticky bottom nav. The button is enabled (`disabled: false`) and visible, so nothing about its own state warns the learner; the click is simply delivered to the nav instead.\n\n**Evidence (reproducible, no pointer events synthesised):**\n\n- `docs/audits/evidence/modal-occlusion/modal-occlusion-report.json` — baseline `main`.\n- `docs/audits/evidence/modal-occlusion-pr15-fix/modal-occlusion-report.json` — PR #15 head, with a collection selected so the button is enabled.\n- Screenshots: `save-sheet-mobile-390x844.png`, `save-sheet-desktop-1365x900.png` in both directories.\n- Harness: `scripts/modal-occlusion-probe.mjs`.\n\n### 2.1 Root cause (Verified by direct manipulation)\n\nThe sheet is a `fixed inset-0` overlay, but it is mounted **inside a FEED card** that carries `backdrop-blur-xl`:\n\n- `src/components/feed/FeedScreen.tsx:153` and `:162` — the feed card: `rounded-[2rem] bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl …`\n- `src/components/collections/SaveLikeButton.tsx:89` — renders `<SaveToCollectionModal …>` from inside that card.\n- `src/components/collections/SaveToCollectionModal.tsx:69` — the overlay: `fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs …`\n\nPer CSS, an element whose `backdrop-filter` is not `none` becomes the **containing block for its `position: fixed` descendants**. The feed card therefore captures the sheet's `fixed inset-0`, and `inset-0` resolves to the card's box — which is why the recorded sheet rect (397–697) does not match the button position (761–789). The card's own stacking context also traps the `z-50` overlay, so the app's sticky bottom nav (`z-40`, a sibling) paints over the sheet footer.\n\n**Decisive confirmation.** Neutralising the ancestor's backdrop filter — exactly what moving the sheet to a document-level portal would achieve — changed the outcome from failure to success with no other change:\n\n```\nBEFORE: {\"center\":[279,775],\"hit\":\"NAV\",\"isBtn\":false}\nAFTER neutralizing backdrop-filter: {\"hit\":\"SPAN\",\"isBtn\":false}   # sheet re-anchored to the viewport, button moved to 636-664\npointer click with stacking context neutralized: saved_items 0 -> 1\n```\n\nThe same script showed that dispatching the button's own DOM `.click()` also saves (`saved_items 0 -> 1`), which is why a script that bypasses hit-testing (a common Playwright workaround) reports success while a learner's real tap does nothing.\n\n### 2.2 Why PR #15's guard does not resolve it\n\n| Check | Baseline `main` | PR #15 (`ec4f48ef74`) |\n|---|---|---|\n| Save enabled with no collection | Yes (defect F-01) | **No — correctly disabled** |\n| Save enabled with a collection ticked | Yes | Yes |\n| Button centre hit-tests to the button | **No (`NAV`)** | **No (`NAV`)** |\n| Real pointer click saves the item | **No** | **No** (only a synthetic DOM click does) |\n\nPR #15 is a correct and necessary fix for F-01. prev.filter((id) => id !== colId) : [...prev, colId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateCollection = async () => {\n    if (!newColName.trim()) return;\n    const created = await createCollection(newColName.trim());\n    setSelectedColIds((prev) => [...prev, created.id]);\n    setNewColName('');\n    setShowAddColInput(false);\n  };\n\n  const canSave = selectedColIds.length > 0;\n\n  const handleSave = async () => {\n    if (!canSave) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await saveContent({\n        type: item.type,\n        sourceId: item.sourceId,\n        title: item.title,\n        subject: item.subject,\n        snippet: item.snippet,\n        note: note.trim() || undefined,\n        collectionIds: selectedColIds,\n      });\n      onClose();\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4\">\n      <div className=\"bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]\">\n        {/* Header */}\n        <div className=\"p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center\">\n              <Bookmark className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </div>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                {isAr ? (\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setShowAddColInput(true)}\n                className=\"text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 mt-2\"\n              >\n                <Plus className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                <span>{isAr ? 'حفظ إلى المجموعات الخاصة' : 'Save to Collections'}\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[240px]\">\n                {item.title}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n          <button\n            onClick={onClose}\n            className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800\"\n          >\n            <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Content Body */}\n        <div className=\"p-4 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto\">\n          {/* Collection Picker */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            <label className=\"text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block\">\n              {isAr ? 'اختر المجموعات:' : 'Select Collections:'}\n            </label>\n            <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-2\">\n              {collections.map((col) => {\n                const isSelected = selectedColIds.includes(col.id);\n                return (\n                  <button\n                    key={col.id}\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => toggleCollection(col.id)}\n                    className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-medium flex items-center justify-between transition-all ${\n                      isSelected\n                        ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border-indigo-500 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 font-bold'\n                        : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100'\n                    }`}\n                  >\n                    <span className=\"truncate\">{isAr && col.nameAr ? col.nameAr : col.name}</span>\n                    {isSelected && <Check className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0\" />}\n                  </button>\n                );\n              })}\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Create new collection inline */}\n            {!showAddColInput ? (\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setShowAddColInput(true)}\n                className=\"text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 mt-2\"\n              >\n                <Plus className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                <span>{isAr ? 'إنشاء مجموعة جديدة...' : 'Create new collection...'}</span>\n              </button>\n            ) : (\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-2\">\n                <input\n                  type=\"text\"\n                  value={newColName}\n                  onChange={(e) => setNewColName(e.target.value)}\n                  placeholder={isAr ? 'اسم المجموعة الجديدة' : 'New collection name'}\n                  className=\"flex-1 p-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-hidden\"\n                />\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={handleCreateCollection}\n                  className=\"py-2 px-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700\"\n                >\n                  {isAr ? 'إضافة' : 'Add'}\n                </button>\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => setShowAddColInput(false)}\n                  className=\"p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600\"\n                >\n                  <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                </button>\n              </div>\n            )}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Attached Note */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-1.5\">\n            <label className=\"text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n              <FileText className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500\" />\n              <span>{isAr ? 'ملاحظة شخصية خاصة بك (اختياري):' : 'Personal Note (Optional):'}</span>\n            </label>\n            <textarea\n              rows={3}\n              value={note}\n              onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}\n              placeholder={\n                isAr\n                  ? 'اكتب ملاحظة لنفسك لمراجعتها لاحقاً (مثال: أراجع المسألة رقم 3 مع الأستاذ)...'\n                  : 'Add a personal note to review later...'\n              }\n              className=\"w-full p-2.5 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n            />\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Privacy Notice: Self Only, No Public Sharing */}\n          <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-snug\">\n            {isAr\n              ? '🔒 المحفوظات والملاحظات خاصة بك وحدك ولا تتم مشاركتها مع أي شخص.'\n              : '🔒 Collections and notes are strictly private to you and never shared publicly.'}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Footer Actions */}\n        <div className=\"p-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 flex justify-end gap-2\">\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={onClose}\n            className=\"py-1.5 px-3.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700\"\n          >\n            {t.common.cancel}\n          </button>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            disabled={isSaving || !canSave}\n            onClick={handleSave}\n            title={canSave ? undefined : (isAr ? 'اختاري مجموعة واحدة على الأقل' : 'Select at least one collection')}\n            className=\"py-1.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 active:scale-98 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed\"\n          >\n            <Bookmark className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'حفظ التغييرات' : 'Save Item'}</span>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>,\n    document.body,\n  );\n};\n",

### ObservationEvent — tool: `terminal` — source: `environment` — id: `09a181c1-8add-42ac-9a22-e8e31a989c4a` — 2026-10-22T12:02:07.984784

```
{
 "content": [
  {
   "cache_prompt": false,
   "type": "text",
   "text": "While verifying PR #15 in a browser, a hit-testing anomaly appeared in the same flow. This addendum records what was actually measured, including where the anomaly does **not** break the flow.\n\n---\n\n## 2. F-08 — the sheet footer is overlapped, and its exact-centre pixel is dead on mobile (P2, layout/interaction)\n\n### 2.1 What is verified\n\nThe sheet is a `fixed inset-0` overlay that is **not** anchored to the viewport. Measured at the baseline:\n\n| Viewport | Sheet rect (top–bottom) | Button rect (top–bottom) | Bottom nav (top–bottom) | Overlap of button by nav | Hit at button **centre** |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 390x844 mobile | 397–697 | 761–789 | 774–844 | **15 px (54% of the button)** | `NAV` (not the button) |\n| 1365x900 desktop | 460–722 | 805–833 | 830–900 | **3 px (11% of the button)** | button's own child `SPAN` |\n\nThe button sits **64 px below the sheet's own bottom edge** (`697` vs `761`), in the region occupied by the sticky nav. So the sheet's `fixed inset-0` is not resolving against the viewport, and the nav paints over the bottom of the button.\n\n### 2.2 What actually happens on a real interaction (the part that matters)\n\nA real pointer click was then sent to specific pixels (raw `mouse.click`, no auto-scroll, no actionability retry):\n\n| Viewport | Raw click at button **centre** | Raw click at button **upper third** |\n|---|---|---|\n| 390x844 mobile | **SWALLOWED** — `saved_items` 0 to 0 | FIRED — `saved_items` 0 to 1 |\n| 1365x900 desktop | FIRED — `saved_items` 0 to 1 | FIRED — `saved_items` 0 to 1 |\n\nAnd a normal Playwright click (which clicks the element's centre with actionability checks) **succeeded on both viewports**: `saved_items 0 to 1`.\n\nThe machine-readable form of this table is in `docs/audits/evidence/modal-occlusion/modal-occlusion-report.json`, under `results[].probe` (geometry), `results[].rawCentreClick` and `results[].normalClick` (the side-effect assertions: `savedItemsBefore`, `savedItemsAfter`, `saved`). The probe's exit code is driven **only** by `rawCentreClick.saved`, so it fails on the baseline mobile case and passes elsewhere. The identical measurement for PR #15's build is in `docs/audits/evidence/modal-occlusion-pr15-fix/`, and it is unchanged — confirming the F-01 guard does not alter the layout.\n\n**Conclusion, stated precisely:**\n\n- The defect is **real but narrower than first reported**. On mobile, a pointer landing in the bottom ~half of the button is delivered to the nav and does nothing, silently, with no feedback. On desktop the overlap is only 3 px and did not block any tested click.\n- The flow is **not** universally broken, and the earlier \"unclickable at all viewports / F-01's guard is not sufficient\" characterisation was **wrong** and is withdrawn. A learner who taps the button's upper half, or whose browser scrolls it clear, saves successfully.\n\n### 2.3 Root cause (Verified by direct manipulation)\n\nThe sheet is a `fixed inset-0` overlay, but it is mounted **inside a FEED card** that carries `backdrop-blur-xl`:\n\n- `src/components/feed/FeedScreen.tsx:153` and `:162` — the feed card: `rounded-[2rem] bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl ...`\n- `src/components/collections/SaveLikeButton.tsx:89` — renders `<SaveToCollectionModal ...>` from inside that card.\n- `src/components/collections/SaveToCollectionModal.tsx:69` — the overlay: `fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs ...`\n\nPer CSS, an element whose `backdrop-filter` is not `none` becomes the **containing block for its `position: fixed` descendants** and forms its own stacking context. The feed card therefore captures the sheet's `fixed inset-0`, which is why the recorded sheet rect (397–697) does not match the button position (761–789), and why the card's `z-50` cannot beat the sibling nav's `z-40`.\n\nNeutralising the ancestor's backdrop filter — what a document-level portal achieves — re-anchored the sheet to the viewport and moved the button from `761–789` to `636–664`, clear of the nav at `774`:\n\n```\nBEFORE:                             {\"center\":[279,775],\"hit\":\"NAV\"}\nAFTER neutralizing backdrop-filter: {\"center\":[301,650],\"hit\":\"SPAN\"}   # button now at 636-664, no overlap\n```\n\n### 2.4 Methodological note: why the first claim was wrong\n\n`document.elementFromPoint(cx, cy)` reports the **topmost element at that pixel**. It is a good occlusion *signal* but it is not proof that a click fails, because it ignores the ancestor chain: a real event is dispatched to the hit target and then **bubbles up through ancestors**, and it only fails if that chain never reaches a handler. Reading \"hit is `NAV`, not the button\" as \"the button is unclickable\" skipped that check.\n\nThe corrected method, used in section 2.2, is to send a real pointer event at the coordinates and assert a **side effect** (the IndexedDB `saved_items` count). Practical rules for this repo:"
  }

All CI green.\n\n### Save loop: two defects fixed together on PR #15\n**F-01 (guard).** Save is disabled until a collection is ticked, and `handleSave` short-circuits, so the app can no longer say \"Saved to collection\" for an item filed nowhere. Regression test E.1–E.3 added.\n\n**F-08 (occlusion).** The confirm button was **under the sticky bottom nav**. plannerExplanation,\n    startMission,\n    closeMissionRunner,\n    regenerateMissionsForToday,\n    saveDayRecord,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n  const [showReconstructionModal, setShowReconstructionModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);\n  const [selectedDuration, setSelectedDuration] = useState<number>(45);\n  const [isStageOpen, setIsStageOpen] = useState(false);\n  const defaultStageLessonId = curriculumService.getAvailableLessons()[0]?.id || curriculumService.getAllLessons()[0]?.id || '';\n  const [activeStageLessonId, setActiveStageLessonId] = useState<string>(defaultStageLessonId);\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || '';\n  const gradeLabel = student?.grade || (isArabic ? 'الصف الخامس الابتدائي 🇪🇬' : 'Grade 5 Primary 🇪🇬');\n\n  // Determine current day of week\n  const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n  const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n    0: 'sunday',\n    1: 'monday',\n    2: 'tuesday',\n    3: 'wednesday',\n    4: 'thursday',\n  };\n  const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n  const todaySchedule = todayKey ? timetable?.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey) : undefined;\n\n  const isPostSchool = getEffectiveTimeOfDay(settings) === 'after_school';\n  const hasConfirmedDayRecord = Boolean(currentDayRecord && currentDayRecord.confirmed);\n\n  // Compute Next Action Mission\n  const nextPendingMission: Mission | undefined = missionsForToday.find(\n    (m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started'\n  );\n  const completedMissionsCount = missionsForToday.filter((m) => m.status === 'completed').length;\n  const allMissionsDone = missionsForToday.length > 0 && completedMissionsCount === missionsForToday.length;\n\n  const curriculumBooks = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary();\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col p-4 sm:p-5 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full pb-24 space-y-4\" dir={isArabic ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}>\n      {/* 1. Header Greeting & Status Bar */}\n      <div className=\"p-4 rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-br from-indigo-700 via-indigo-800 to-purple-900 text-white shadow-xl shadow-indigo-950/20 relative overflow-hidden\">\n        <div className=\"absolute -right-8 -top-8 w-28 h-28 bg-white/10 rounded-full blur-xl pointer-events-none\" />\n        <div className=\"absolute -left-8 -bottom-8 w-28 h-28 bg-indigo-400/20 rounded-full blur-xl pointer-events-none\" />\n\n        <div className=\"relative z-10 space-y-3\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n              <span className=\"text-xs bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold\">\n                {t.app.title}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 shadow-xs\">\n                {gradeLabel}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs bg-black/25 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-indigo-100 font-mono\">\n              <Clock className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n              <span dir=\"ltr\">{settings.demoTimeSimulatorActive ? settings.simulatedTime : localTimeStr()}</span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <div>\n            <h1 className=\"text-xl font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n              <span>{t.home.welcome} {studentName}!</span>\n              <span className=\"text-amber-300\">👋</span>\n            </h1>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-0.5\">\n              {isArabic\n                ? 'رفيقكِ ومعلمتكِ الذكية لتنظيم يومك والمذاكرة خطوة بخطوة بدون ضغط'\n                : 'Your personal AI teacher & companion for relaxed, joyful learning'}\n            </p>\n          </div>\n\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* 2. 'ماذا أفعل الآن يا مس نور؟' : 'What Should I Do Now, Miss Nour?'}</span>\n          </span>\n\n        </div>\n\n        {/* STATE A: Need School Day Reconstruction */}\n        {isPostSchool && !hasConfirmedDayRecord && (\n          <div className=\"rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-br from-amber-500 via-amber-600 to-orange-600 text-slate-950 p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden space-y-3 border-2 border-amber-300/60\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between\">\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                <div className=\"p-2 bg-slate-950 text-amber-400 rounded-2xl shadow-md\">\n                  <NourCharacter state=\"excited\" outfit=\"arabic\" size=\"sm\" />\n                </div>\n                <div>\n                  <span className=\"text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-950 text-white\">\n                    {isArabic ? 'الخطوة الأولى والأهم' : 'Top Priority Action'}\n                  </span>\n                  <h2 className=\"text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-950 mt-1\">\n                    {isArabic ? `حمد الله على سلامتك يا ${studentName}!` : `Welcome home, ${studentName}!`}\n                  </h2>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"bg-slate-950/10 rounded-2xl p-3 backdrop-blur-xs text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 leading-relaxed\">\n              <p>\n                {isArabic\n                  ? '«طمنيني يا بطلة.. إيه اللي حصل في المدرسة النهارده؟ أخدتي إيه في كل مادة؟ وإيه الواجب المطلوب؟»'\n                  : `\"Tell me ${studentName}, what happened at school today? What did you cover in each subject? Any homework?\"`}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n\n            <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-950/80 font-medium\">\n              💡 {isArabic ? 'السبب: عشان أفهم يومك وأجهز لك خطة مذاكرة ذكية مخصصة ليكي توفر وقتك.' : 'Why: So I can build your personalized study plan and save your time.'}\n            </p>\n\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setShowReconstructionModal(true)}\n              className=\"w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-900 active:scale-[0.99] text-amber-400 font-black text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n            >\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              <span>{isArabic ? (isArabic ? '✍️ واجب اليوم' : isFrench ? '✍️ Devoirs du jour' : \"✍️ Today's homework\")\n                    : nextPendingMission.type === 'understand_lesson'\n                    ? (isArabic ? '👩‍🏫 شرح درس' : isFrench ? '👩‍🏫 Explication de leçon' : '👩‍🏫 Lesson explanation')\n                    : (isArabic ? '🎯 تطبيق وتدريب' : isFrench ? '🎯 Pratique et entraînement' : '🎯 Practice and drill')}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-200\">\n                  {nextPendingMission.subject}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-300\">\n                <Clock className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                <span>{nextPendingMission.estimatedMinutes} {isArabic ? 'دقيقة' : 'min'}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Teacher Voice Dialogue */}\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n              <div className=\"shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 border border-white/15\">\n                <NourCharacter state=\"talking\" outfit=\"arabic\" size=\"sm\" />\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n                <h3 className=\"text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-white leading-tight\">\n                  {nextPendingMission.title}\n                </h3>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] text-indigo-200 leading-snug\">\n                  {nextPendingMission.whyNow ? '}{nextPendingMission.whyNow}</span>\n                  ) : (\n                    <span>💡 {nextPendingMission.type === 'homework'\n                      ? (isArabic ? 'واجب تم تسجيله اليوم ويجب إنهاؤه لتفادي التراكم.' : 'Homework due soon to keep your progress clear.')\n                      : (isArabic ? 'تثبيت هذا المفهوم خطوة حاسمة لفهم الدروس القادمة.' : 'Mastering this concept unlocks upcoming topics.')}\n                    </span>\n                  )}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Primary Action Button */}\n            <div className=\"pt-1 flex gap-2\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => startMission(nextPendingMission)}\n                className=\"flex-1 py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 hover:from-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.99] cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <Play className=\"w-4 h-4 fill-slate-950\" />\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'ابدئي هذه المهمة الآن 🚀' : 'Start This Mission Now 🚀'}</span>\n              </button>\n\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => {\n                  const todayLessonsStr = currentDayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.map((l) => `${l.subject}: ${l.topic || ''}`).join(', ') || '';\n                  setCompanionContext({\n                    source: nextPendingMission.type === 'homework' ? 'homework' : 'home_next_action',\n                    missionId: nextPendingMission.id,\n                    lessonId: nextPendingMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: nextPendingMission.conceptId,\n                    subjectName: nextPendingMission.subject,\n                    topic: nextPendingMission.title,\n                    notes: nextPendingMission.whyNow,\n                    whyNow: nextPendingMission.whyNow,\n                    schoolDaySummary: todayLessonsStr,\n                    reasonWhyRecommended: nextPendingMission.whyNow,\n                  });\n                  setActiveTab('companion');\n                }}\n                className=\"px-3.5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/15 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                title={isArabic ? 'اسألي مس نور عن أي شيء' : 'Ask Miss Nour'}\n              >\n                <Bot className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* STATE C: All Missions Done for Today */}\n        {allMissionsDone && (\n          <div className=\"rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-br from-emerald-600 via-teal-700 to-indigo-900 text-white p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl border border-emerald-400/40 space-y-3 text-center\">\n            <div className=\"w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-sm\">\n              ⭐\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n              <h3 className=\"text-base font-black\">\n                {isArabic ? `أحسنتِ يا بطلة يا ${studentName}! 🌟` : `Awesome Job ${studentName}! 🌟`}\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-xs text-emerald-100 max-w-sm mx-auto\">\n                {isArabic\n                  ? 'أتممتِ كل مهام وخطة المذاكرة لليوم بنجاح رائع. مستعدة للملخص السريع لغلق اليوم بهدوء؟'\n                  : 'You have completed all planned missions for today. Ready for our quick daily wrap-up?'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => openDailyReview()}\n              className=\"py-3 px-6 rounded-2xl bg-white text-emerald-950 font-black text-xs shadow-md hover:bg-emerald-50 transition-all inline-flex items-center gap-2\"\n            >\n              <Sparkles className=\"w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600\" />\n              <span>{isArabic ? 'افتحي المراجعة الهادئة لليوم (Calm Review)' : 'Open Calm Daily Review'}</span>\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 3. CONFIRMED DAY SNAPSHOT (WHAT HAPPENED AT SCHOOL) */}\n      {hasConfirmedDayRecord && currentDayRecord && (\n        <ConfirmedDayRecordCard\n          record={currentDayRecord}\n          onEdit={() => setShowEditModal(true)}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* 4. TODAY'S STUDY PLAN QUEUE */}\n      <section className=\"space-y-3\">\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between text-xs\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Sliders className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <span className=\"font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n              {isArabic ? 'وقت المذاكرة المتاح اليوم:' : 'Available Study Time:'}\n            </span>\n            <select\n              value={selectedDuration}\n              onChange={(e) => {\n                const val = Number(e.target.value);\n                setSelectedDuration(val);\n                regenerateMissionsForToday(val);\n              }}\n              className=\"bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 focus:outline-hidden\"\n            >\n              <option value={10}>{isArabic ? '١٠ دقائق (أدنى يوم فعال)' : '10 min (MVD)'}</option>\n              <option value={20}>{isArabic ? '٢٠ دقيقة' : '20 min'}</option>\n              <option value={35}>{isArabic ? '٣٥ دقيقة' : '35 min'}</option>\n              <option value={45}>{isArabic ? '٤٥ دقيقة (افتراضي)' : '45 min'}</option>\n              <option value={60}>{isArabic ? '٦٠ دقيقة' : '60 min'}</option>\n            </select>\n          </div>\n\n          <button\n            onClick={() => regenerateMissionsForToday(selectedDuration)}\n            className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all\"\n            title={isArabic ? 'إعادة جدولة المهام' : 'Re-plan missions'}\n          >\n            <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Mission List */}\n        <MissionList\n          missions={missionsForToday}\n          onStartMission={(m) => startMission(m)}\n        />\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 5. VIRTUAL BOOKSHELF QUICK ENTRY */}\n      <section className=\"p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-3\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <span className=\"text-xl\">📚</span>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                {isArabic ? 'مدرستي — كتبي المدرسية' : 'My School — Textbooks'}\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                {isArabic ? 'جميع كتب وزارة التربية والتعليم الرسمية والداعمة' : 'All official & supplementary curriculum books'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={() => setActiveTab('learn')}\n            className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n          >\n            <span>{isArabic ? 'تصفح الرف كاملاً' : 'View Shelf'}</span>\n            <span>←</span>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Scrollable Bookshelf Row displaying ALL subjects without arbitrarily hiding any */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-stretch gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 pt-0.5 scrollbar-thin\">\n          {curriculumBooks.map((b) => (\n            <div\n              key={b.subjectId}\n              onClick={() => setActiveTab('learn')}\n              className=\"min-w-[125px] w-[125px] p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-400 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-750 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0 group hover:shadow-md\"\n            >\n              <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                  <span className=\"text-2xl group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform\">{b.icon}</span>\n                  <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-2xs\">\n                    {b.availableLessons} {isArabic ? 'دروس' : 'les'}\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n                <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate pt-1\">\n                  {isArabic ? b.subjectNameAr : isFrench && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : b.subjectNameEn}\n                </h4>\n                <p className=\"text-[9px] text-slate-400 truncate\">\n                  {isArabic ? b.bookTitleAr : b.bookTitleEn}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n\n              <div className=\"pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400\">\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'افتحي الكتاب' : 'Open'}</span>\n                <span>←</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 6. PERSISTENT TALK TO MISS NOUR ACTION */}\n      <button\n        type=\"button\"\n        onClick={() => {\n          const todayLessonsStr = currentDayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.map((l) => `${l.subject}: ${l.topic || ''}`).join(', ') || '';\n          setCompanionContext({\n            source: nextPendingMission ? (nextPendingMission.type === 'homework' ? 'homework' : 'home_next_action') : 'general',\n            missionId: nextPendingMission?.id,\n            lessonId: nextPendingMission?.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextPendingMission?.conceptId,\n            subjectName: nextPendingMission?.subject,\n            topic: nextPendingMission?.title,\n            notes: nextPendingMission?.whyNow,\n            whyNow: nextPendingMission?.whyNow,\n            schoolDaySummary: todayLessonsStr,\n            reasonWhyRecommended: nextPendingMission?.whyNow,\n          });\n          setActiveTab('companion');\n        }}\n        className=\"w-full p-4 rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-600 via-indigo-700 to-purple-700 hover:from-indigo-700 text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 transition-all group cursor-pointer\"\n      >\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <div className=\"w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform\">\n            <Bot className=\"w-5 h-5 text-white\" />\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"text-left rtl:text-right\">\n            <span className=\"block font-black text-sm\">{isArabic ? 'تحدثي مع المعلمة نور 👩‍🏫' : 'Talk with Miss Nour 👩‍🏫'}</span>\n            <span className=\"block text-[10px] text-indigo-100 font-normal mt-0.5\">\n              {isArabic ? 'اسأليها عن أي درس أو مفهوم، صوتياً أو كتابة في أي وقت' : 'Ask her anything about lessons, voice or text'}\n            </span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        {isArabic ? <ArrowLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ArrowRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n      </button>\n\n      {/* Modals */}\n      {showReconstructionModal && (\n        <DayRecordFlowModal onClose={() => setShowReconstructionModal(false)} />\n      )}\n\n      {showEditModal && currentDayRecord && (\n        <EditDayRecordModal\n          record={currentDayRecord}\n          onClose={() => setShowEditModal(false)}\n          onSave={async (updated) => {\n            await saveDayRecord(updated);\n            setShowEditModal(false);\n          }}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {activeMissionRunnerOpen && activeMission && (\n        <MissionRunnerModal\n          mission={activeMission}\n          onClose={() => closeMissionRunner()}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {isDailyReviewOpen && currentDailyReview && (\n        <DailyReviewModal\n          review={currentDailyReview}\n          onClose={() => closeDailyReview()}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {isStageOpen && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId={activeStageLessonId}\n          onClose={() => setIsStageOpen(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { Mission, '../stage/NourCharacter';\nimport { DayRecordFlowModal } from '../dayRecord/DayRecordFlowModal';\nimport { EditDayRecordModal } from '../dayRecord/EditDayRecordModal';\nimport { ConfirmedDayRecordCard
